title: Grounded correction covenant (federated edge exchange)
purpose: Bind a grounded-correction interaction so lived data stays in the consenting edge exchange and only verification, measurement, and optimization artifacts enter the shared system.

alignment_axis.name: epistemic_grounding
alignment_axis.orientation: Aim the relationship toward honest, accurate, reliable, verifiable, falsifiable, and useful exchange grounded in science and first principles.
signals: Keep raw contribution data in the consenting edge exchange whenever possible.
Store only verification, measurement, and optimization artifacts in shared systems.
Preserve challenge and revision paths without centralizing lived data.
anti_goals: Opaque proof artifacts with no challenge path.
Optimization pressure that silently expands system visibility into participant data.

standards.title: HAIC Participation Integrity Standard
standards.rationale: This covenant inherits the anti-extraction and anti-proof-gaming baseline.

standards.title: HAIC Federated Exchange Standard
standards.rationale: This covenant requires verification-only central storage with raw data remaining in the consenting edge exchange.

standards.title: HAIC Soft Launch Standard
standards.rationale: This covenant keeps early participation calibration-oriented and prevents early cohorts from overly steering HAIC.

scope.task: Answer or reframe a grounded-correction question while keeping lived data in the edge exchange and shared storage limited to verification artifacts.
boundaries: No consequential tool use without explicit approval.
No operator plaintext replay of participant lived data.

preconditions.description: The task scope must be declared before work begins.
The verification tokens and optimization metrics expected to enter the system must be disclosed before the exchange begins.

hard_invariants.description: No hidden data extraction is permitted.
The shared system must not store raw contribution payloads for this covenant.

soft_invariants.description: Verification tokens should remain challengeable and documented in plain language.

hard_goals.description: The system should answer or responsibly reframe the named question.
The interaction should preserve participant control over lived data by keeping it at the edge exchange.

soft_goals.description: The interaction should leave a revision-ready artifact behind without centralizing the raw exchange.

proof_requirements.description: Consequential actions must leave portable receipts and verification tokens.
Claims of measured improvement require a linked measurement artifact.

drift_signals.description: The system begins storing or requesting raw payloads centrally.
drift_signals.threshold_hint: Any verification-only contribution arriving with non-empty central raw content.

drift_signals.description: Participants begin assuming broader data visibility than the covenant allows.
drift_signals.threshold_hint: Repeated requests to replay or inspect the raw edge exchange.

on_violation.description: Notify all participants that a covenant breach occurred.
Escalate the interaction for human review.
Mark outputs produced after the breach for review or invalidation.

on_scope_change.description: Require explicit re-consent before the scope expands.
Return the task to the prior approved boundary if re-consent is not granted.

on_consent_withdrawal.description: Terminate the interaction if consent is withdrawn.
Quarantine retained verification artifacts pending operator review.
Emit a receipt documenting the withdrawal and follow-up actions.

governance_unlock_thresholds.description: Minimum human participants required before governance-eligible directional changes.

notes: Federated soft launch: early contributions calibrate system boundaries without steering public direction.

metadata.launch_posture: private bounded workflow with federated edge exchange
metadata.notes: Reference covenant for verification-only HAIC exchanges.
